name: @epicdm/saga-server
description: SAGA reference hub — Cloudflare Worker implementing the SAGA API (agents, documents, transfers)

scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.//deploy:production: Production deploys MUST follow the runbook in scripts/deploy-production.md — backup D1 first, then migrate, then deploy. The script below is intentionally a worker-only deploy (no migration chained) so it cannot accidentally apply a migration without a backup. See the standing rule in MEMORY.md regarding greenfield-against-production posture.
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply saga-hub-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply saga-hub --env production --remote
